$doc: P2-P4 event-type registry. bl_compose.py fails loudly on a `type` not listed here (SCHEMA.md's open-but-checked-in registry). Add a type here before using it; task-82380776 (census of the reference) and later workers extend this list as they measure more of the motion grammar.

hook_slide.measured: SKILL.md §6d hook opening: 0.23->1.43s slide-down, power1.out, scale unchanged
hook_slide.refs: none required — the hook has no earlier-layer event to bind to

avatar_shrink.refs: optional: the P1 plate id of the plate being shrunk onto

hard_cut.measured: SKILL.md §6d: 0 in-between frames, exits from composite or a section-change entry
hard_cut.refs: optional: the P1 plate id either side of the cut

spotlight.measured: SKILL.md §6d: dim-to-grey + bright circle, e.g. 4.40-5.15s circle centre x25%/y28% r20%w
spotlight.refs: required: the P1 real-footage plate id being spotlit

highlight_sweep.measured: SKILL.md §6d: left->right yellow bar, ~0.9s, centroid x40%->55-60%
highlight_sweep.refs: required: the P1 plate id whose value is being highlighted

zoom.measured: SKILL.md §6d: continuous pan/push on the evidence plate, e.g. XM page 2.0-4.4s
zoom.refs: required: the P1 plate id being zoomed

fade.measured: generic opacity in/out — not the kinetic wipe, which is P3's headline
fade.refs: required: the element (P1 plate or P2 event) being faded

caption_chip.measured: SKILL.md §6d: small dark chip above the head in composite mode, ~37-40% of frame height
caption_chip.refs: required: the P1 composite plate id this chip labels

headline.measured: template's kinetic() generator — 1-3 line wipe-in headline
headline.refs: optional: a P1/P2 event this headline explains

data_label.measured: a label pinned to one evidence value on a real-footage plate
data_label.refs: required: the P1 real-footage plate id and, if lit, the P2 spotlight/highlight_sweep id

sfx.measured: SKILL.md: sound effects out of scope until a licensed, human-annotated library exists — schema-only today
sfx.refs: required: the P1/P2/P3 event id this sound is tied to, e.g. a P2 avatar_shrink's whoosh

music_bed.measured: continuous soundtrack under a stretch of the cut
music_bed.refs: optional: the P1 plate id(s) the bed underscores
